title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price. AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

You mentioned your focus on customers with volume, so the attached packages offer a longer commitment for planning security. One package includes the AS-14404 clause you proposed. Which of these packages can you sign? Are there cheaper variants you would suggest?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We have verified the recent decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices and have adjusted our pricing accordingly. We welcome the 24-month commitment for planning security, but we must include the AS-14404 index clause for a contract of this duration. 

Our current offer includes a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. With the index clause and a 30-day payment term, we can offer a revised price of €5.30 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 - revised package for the 24-month price basis
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We have moved on price in the attached package. It covers 23700 pieces per year over 24 months, with payment at 60 days. We would like to keep a fixed price, so that both sides can plan for the whole term without monthly surcharge calculations and the administrative workload they bring.

Can you sign this package? If a fixed price is difficult for you, which other variant would you suggest?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - revised package for the 24-month price basis
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. For a 24-month commitment, we cannot offer a fixed price due to raw material volatility and must include the AS-14404 index clause. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

With the AS-14404 index clause in place, we can offer a revised price of €5.20 per unit for the 24-month term and 60-day payment. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 - revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer.

We have moved on price again in the attached package. It covers 23700 pieces per year over 24 months, with payment at 60 days. A fixed price spares both sides the monthly surcharge calculations and gives you secured volume for the whole term.

Could you take this package to its next meeting? Your owner also offered to walk us through your calculation of material and hourly rates. We would welcome that if it helps settle the fixed price.

What is the earliest date you could confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current offer is a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. With the index clause included, we can reduce our offer to €5.00 per unit. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our colleagues will contact you to schedule a meeting regarding the cost breakdown and lead time; please also clarify the binding volume you can secure. Please note that this offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body: Thank you. We accept your alternative package as quoted and attach it unchanged; please confirm it.

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for accepting our final offer. We are pleased to confirm the package at €5.10 per unit with the AS-14404 index clause (Preisgleitklausel), 60 days payment (Zahlungsziel), and a 24-month contract term. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. Ourangebot is valid for 14 days. We look forward to our continued partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
